about: L4 texture-zoo fixture and goldens (the test strategy, sections 3.1 and 3.3). Rendered by the exported viewer's --test-render at 640x360 with Stage.ZooCamera, the fixed test environment and light, no MSAA/TAA/FXAA; textures fetched through SessionAssets from this folder and decoded by the guarded decoder; legacy SL face shader (xform, planar, tint, fullbright, blended alpha, back faces culled). Tolerance: the terrain goldens'. Goldens are proposed by the render script and approved by a person after viewing.

fixture.provenance: 64x64 images generated by Viewer.Shell.TextureZoo.Pixels and encoded with LibreMetaverse 3.1.6's encoder (CoreJ2K); layout by TextureZoo.Make() (TextureZooTests checks the file against it); the mesh cube is fixtures/meshes/mesh-cube-6face.llmesh
fixture.redistribution: generated in this repo; no third-party content
fixture.negative_control: --tr-alter=offset: the plain box's texture offset +0.5 in U through the core; must fail the diff

detail_fixture.provenance: a 512x512 image generated by Viewer.Shell.DetailZoo.Pixels and encoded with LibreMetaverse 3.1.6's encoder (CoreJ2K); layout by DetailZoo.Make() (DetailZooTests checks the files against it); the sphere is fixtures/meshes/mesh-sphere.llmesh
detail_fixture.redistribution: generated in this repo; no third-party content
detail_fixture.camera: Stage.DetailCamera (--tr-camera=detail): at (40, 128, 30), looking east, 60 degrees; a wall and a sphere at 8, 24, 48 and 96 m
detail_fixture.goldens: golden-detail-distance-vulkan.png and golden-detail-distance-d3d12.png, approved by the project maintainer after viewing

goldens.proposed: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti; --tr-budget=48k: all three textures resident, the lowest-priority one (the sphere's gradient) one discard level lower (32 px), not on its placeholder; 49,151 B resident
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti; --tr-budget=12k: only coarsest levels fit; two textures at their coarsest (32 px), the lowest-priority one (the sphere's gradient) on its average-colour placeholder

budget_negative_control: Each budget golden against the other budget (48k vs 12k) must fail the diff. The default budget is no longer a control for 48k: there only the smooth gradient differs, by one level (max 3/255, below the threshold)

fuzz_corpus.about: Hostile codestreams that must be refused within bounded time and memory (TextureFuzzTests.Corpus() is the generator; NV_WRITE_TEXTURE_FUZZ=1 rewrites them). All are built from our own content (TextureFixtures.Opaque64 and generated bytes); none comes from grid content (ADR-011). Decodes of them run only in the decode probe, a child process with a deadline (Viewer.Core.DecodeProbe).

entries.packet-data-ff.j2c: Our own 64x64 texture with every byte of its packet data (after SOD, up to EOC) set to 0xFF; headers intact. Before the bit-stuffing rule in J2kGuard it hung CoreJ2K 2.3.3.91's packet-header reader (the child was killed at its 20 s deadline); now refused at once
